intended_use: Prepare evidence-linked summaries and follow-up tasks for clinical staff. No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing or treatment decision.
explicit_non_goals: No silent writes to source clinical records

architecture.summary: Read-only clinical context enters a bounded processing layer; CareOS creates evidence-linked draft summaries/tasks; qualified staff review before downstream action.

categories: patient identifiers only if required by deployment
data.retention: TBD; minimise and prefer references over duplicate storage

security.encryption: In transit and at rest for deployment-controlled data
security.logging: Append-only audit intent; no sensitive prompt logging by default

ai_act.risk_assessment: Requires intended-use and deployment-context review; this synthetic passport makes no legal classification
transparency_controls: Human reviewer required before consequential action

domain_regulation.assessment: Qualification depends on intended purpose and claims; human review required
Classify the deployed system role before assuming a specific confirmation procedure is required

workforce.training_plan: 30-minute workflow review + pilot onboarding + feedback channel

evaluations.name: Evidence-grounding eval
evaluations.result: Target and corpus to be agreed with clinical owner

evaluations.name: Critical omission / contradiction eval
evaluations.result: Target and corpus to be agreed with clinical safety

evaluations.name: Workflow usability test
evaluations.result: Test with real end users before production claim

rollback.procedure: Disable CareOS integration and revert to existing workflow; demonstrate before bounded pilot
